verdict.rationale: Fivetran offers a REST API for programmatic pipeline setup/management, a Connector SDK for custom connectors, and an official MCP server plus AI coding-agent plugins (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI) that let agents build/test/deploy connectors via natural language, supporting headless scaffolding and operation. However, evidence doesn't show a single unified CLI for full pipeline lifecycle (source setup, transformation, destination) purely headlessly — much of the workflow still centers on the dashboard/API combination, and the MCP server's write/delete scope is gated behind manual config. missing for 10: a documented end-to-end CLI/API flow that scaffolds+configures+runs a full pipeline (source to transform to destination) without dashboard steps, and independent hands-on validation of the agent plugins actually completing such a pipeline.
